activation.details: The board dispatcher and gateway must be running (normal Hermes session); scripts apply immediately after install.

payload.effects: Six personas active on the Hermes board with two one-command pipeline recipes; human-gated conclusions by notification; per-profile model and tool configuration isolated from other agents.
payload.explanation: Install is deliberately conservative because the profiles are full runtime homes: ./install.sh runs in dry-run by default and --apply writes; an existing SOUL.md or config.yaml is skipped unless --force, and config.yaml is only created from config.example.yaml when absent; memories, auth, databases and logs are never touched. Credential-shaped values are placeholders to be filled by the operator. Two orchestration commands are installed into the user bin directory. Vendored skills are named, not copied, in skill.lock.json.

steps: cd ~/hermes-stack and run ./install.sh to preview the writes
Run ./install.sh --apply (add --force only if you intend to overwrite existing personas)
Fill the placeholders in each created config.yaml: the notification topic variable and your own model endpoints; keep credentials out of the files
Invoke the pipelines by goal: hermes-science-dag --mode analysis "goal" or --mode compute "goal", or the lighter hermes-science-swarm "goal"

payload.rollback: Delete the created profile directories under ~/.hermes/profiles and the two commands from the user bin directory; nothing else is written.
payload.validation_plan: A small analysis-mode goal should produce board cards for science and genio, then audit and review, ending with a director synthesis; the compute mode additionally shows a runner stage between reasoning and audit.
